subject: [hw] IP -> root/K02/IK: --venc-slow needs a kernel interface; slbc_ready already 0; exact minimal ask
body:
IP items for the first phone encode, fast:

(1) slbc_ready: already satisfied. handle_open starts from n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264(), whose memset makes slbc_ready 0, and we do not change it; I will make that explicit in code and STATUS. No vendor read to shim on my side.

(2) --venc-slow: the daemon has no way to set venc_sel. K02 sets N2VC_VENC_PARENT=12 (univpll_d4) inside the kernel at power-on; the only 273 MHz path today is the autotest command 8 bit 0x200, which user space vcodecd cannot invoke. I will add a daemon flag `--venc-slow` and a transport call guarded by `#ifdef RWVC_VENC_SLOW`, but someone must add the ioctl and header line first. Minimal proposal:

  /* RWVC_VENC_SLOW: minor 0 only; set venc_sel to mainpll_d4_d2 = 273 MHz before the first job. */
  #define RWVC_VENC_SLOW RWVC_IOC(0x00000000u, 13, uint32_t)   /* no struct */

K02: one function that writes the same mux/update sequence as the autotest step 1 --slow (CLK_CFG_13 parent 3? the hwv --slow value), only while VEN is off, EPERM while on. IK: allow only minor 0. Header edit is hw-lead. Then vcodecd calls it once after opening the relay when --venc-slow is given, before any power/OPEN.

If you prefer no new ioctl, the alternative is to make K02 power VEN at 273 MHz by default until M4c and drop the flag. Tell me which in the next few minutes; meanwhile I am adding the flag and the guarded call so it works the moment the header lands. vcodecd rebuild + sha after that.
